scope.record_delta: ActualRegisteredBornEffect.transported changes only increment to born.activeEnvironment minus T.paid(selected).environment. It retains prior raw, environment, complete state/Trace, source occurrence, relation boundary, complex and owner. Existing updated_value and full range/zero-fibre APIs evaluate the prior completed sigma under that actual source delta.
scope.environment_sigma: The typed registered request retains born.registered.input.environment. Registered execution Env and decoded born.activeEnvironment remain distinct. Its expression is the previous completed native sigma N.expression(T.paid(selected)); fresh local born residual is a separate expression. No relation-history membership or depth0 value grants fresh zero.
scope.depth_zero: Source Math.mathCurrent(depth) uses finiteVisit(depth+1); depth0 already contains a genuine first paid Step. The var-env0 controls derive old/native zero from their original WB material, receipt and stopped trace, not a zero-depth assumption.
scope.literal_affine: The existing normalization certificate retains literal boundary minus constantMap(valueMap actual decoded born Env boundary). boundary_valueMap connects its scalar readout to the same actual next request; no literal coefficient word is erased or normalized away by assertion.
scope.positive_negative_controls: The actual var-env0 WB receipt/stoppedTrace derives old and native zero. Actual source nextEnvironmentReadAt writes (1,0) or (0,0), producing registered expression value (1,0) or zero and the corresponding nonzero/zero paid coimage via registered_zero_iff.
